id.description: The unique identifier for the form submission

organizationId.description: The unique identifier for the client organization within Certify

mappedData.description: The mapped responses for the form submission. The structure of this object is flexible and can vary based on the form and its fields.

submissionData.description: The raw responses for the form submission. The structure of this object is flexible and can vary based on the form and its fields.

submissionPdf.description: The PDF document of the form submission, if available

submittedBy.description: The flexible data object containing the submitted by information

form.description: Information about the form associated with the submission

formVersionId.description: The id of the version of the form used for this submission

createdAt.description: The date and time when the form submission was created

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the submission

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the form submission was last updated

FormSubmissionSubmittedByResponse.description: Information about who submitted the form

email.description: The email of the user who submitted the form

user.description: The user information of the person who submitted the form
